Package zephyr.daemon.model

Class ZephyrTx

java.lang.Object
zephyr.daemon.model.ZephyrTx
Direct Known Subclasses:
ZephyrTxWallet
public class ZephyrTx extends Object
Represents a transaction on the Zephyr network.

  • Field Details

    • DEFAULT_PAYMENT_ID

      public static final String DEFAULT_PAYMENT_ID
      The payment ID of sixteen zeros, which stands for no payment ID. ZephyrWalletFull reports a transaction with this payment ID as having none (getPaymentId() is null).

    • getPaymentId

      public String getPaymentId()
      Returns the payment ID of the transaction as hex. ZephyrWalletFull shortens a 64-character ID whose last 48 characters are zeros to its first 16 characters, and reports the all-zero ID as null (read in the core's code).
      Returns:
      the payment ID, null if the transaction has none

      this transaction for chaining

    • getFee

      public BigInteger getFee()
      Returns the fee of the transaction in atomic units (10^12 per coin). The fee is paid in the source asset, the asset the transaction spends, also for a conversion. See the user guide, docs/guide/07-sending.md, section "Fees and priorities".
      Returns:
      the fee in atomic units of the source asset, null if unknown

    • getRingSize

      public Integer getRingSize()
      Returns the ring size: the number of outputs each input is hidden among, its own included. ZephyrWalletFull sets the constant 16 (the core's RING_SIZE) on the transactions that createTxs and the sweeps return without reading the built transaction, leaves it null on the transactions of getTxs, and describeTxSet reports the smallest ring of each transaction (read in the core's code).
      Returns:
      the ring size, null if unknown

      Returns:
      this transaction for chaining

    • getUnlockHeight

      public Long getUnlockHeight()
      Returns the unlock time the transaction itself carries: 0 when it sets none, as the transactions this library builds do unless ZephyrTxConfig.setUnlockHeight is used. Received funds and change unlock 10 blocks after the block that contains them in any case; ZephyrTxWallet.isLocked() tells whether they have. See the user guide, docs/guide/05-assets-and-balances.md, section "Locked and unlocked".
      Returns:
      the unlock time (a block height), 0 for none, null if unknown

      Returns:

    • getKey

      public String getKey()
      Returns the secret key of the transaction as hex. ZephyrWalletFull sets it on the transactions that createTxs and the sweeps return; the transactions of getTxs do not carry it, getTxKey(hash) reads it from the wallet. With the key and the hash anyone can check the transaction against an address, so treat it as a secret and do not log it.
      Returns:
      the secret key, null if not known here

      Returns:

    • getOutputs

      public List<ZephyrOutput> getOutputs()
      Returns the outputs of the transaction. For a wallet transaction these are only the wallet's own outputs (ZephyrOutputWallet). ZephyrWalletFull.getTxs fills them only when the query asks for them (ZephyrTxQuery.setIncludeOutputs(true) or an output query), from the same data as getOutputs(), so they carry no asset.
      Returns:
      the outputs, null if not known

    • merge

      public ZephyrTx merge(ZephyrTx tx)
      Merges the information of the given transaction (the same transaction, seen another way) into this one. Fields this one lacks are taken over; states that only move forward (confirmed, relayed, failed, double spend seen, the number of confirmations) take the later value; other fields that both carry must agree, or the merge throws. The given transaction may be modified or referenced afterwards, so do not reuse it.
      Parameters:
      tx - is the transaction to merge into this one
      Returns:
      this transaction for chaining
